title.en: Built-in white panel-door cabinet in a hallway

alt.tr: Koridor duvarına gömülü, çift kanatlı, çerçeveli beyaz boyalı dolap; yanında koyu yeşil taş zemin ve beyaz kapı kasası
alt.en: Built-in white two-door cabinet with raised panels in a hallway, beside a dark green stone floor and white door frame

caption.tr: Koridor duvarına ölçüyle yerleştirilen, çift kanatlı ve kabartma çerçeveli mat beyaz boyalı gömme dolap.
caption.en: A built-in cabinet made to fit the hallway wall, with two raised-panel doors in a matte white paint finish.
